verdict.rationale: Sign-in identity requirements are a fair question for a government immigration portal, so the axis applies. The pack only lists 'Accounts (GCKey, ...)' as a navigation link and never describes the sign-in path, whether it uses credential MFA, or whether an authorized human can complete it remotely. The 'biometrics' in the same link refers to the immigration process, not to sign-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
